service_desc:
Google Cloud VMware Engine (GCVE) is a managed VMware-as-a-Service offering purpose-built-for-VMware workloads which runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and bare metal server deployments. GCVE enables enterprise customers to run VMware virtual machines natively in a dedicated, private software-defined data center (SDDC) within Google Cloud. The GCVE solution allows users to move their on-premises VMware components into a cloud environment without having to majorly disrupt workflows. The primary customer benefit is being able to use existing VMware workflows without having to worry about infrastructure or hiring VMware-adept personnel.

GCVE deploys an entire customer VMware suite stack on Google Cloud Extension hardware. Google Cloud Extensions are colocation centers (COLOs) housing Google production spaces (GPSs) containing Google-owned hardware running GCVE services. This environment includes ESXi (hypervisor), vCenter (management), vSAN (software-defined storage platform), NSX Data Center (network virtualization and system security), and HCC (application migration and workload rebalancing).

Deltek's Costpoint GovCon Cloud Moderate (CP GCCM) supports government contractors with project management, accounting, labor and material management and business intelligence functionalities. CP GCCM provides unstructured data classification and customizable rules to protect the privacy of customers, employees, and partners, as well as an organization’s intellectual property. In addition, the CP GCCM supports capabilities for content protection including data classification and access controls, data retention, and regulation.

CP GCCM offers additional security to support government contractors in meeting their DFARS contractual requirements and helps accelerate DCAA/DCMA and CMMC compliance initiatives. CP GCCM allows contractors a secure process to handle more highly sensitive information, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and ITAR data, eliminating the complexity of additional IT infrastructure or staff.

LabArchives for Government (LG) is a cloud-based SaaS web application that consists of three independent applications: Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN), Inventory, and Scheduler. LG ELN is a cloud-based electronic lab notebook designed for research that enables researchers to capture, manage, store, and share information and data. LG Scheduler is a scheduling solution for labs and research organizations. LG Inventory organizes, tracks, and helps with ordering lab inventory.

The Precisely Data Integrity Suite for Government is a cloud-native solution that provides capabilities for managing and governing data within federal agencies and other regulated environments. The cloud services of the Data Integrity Suite help organizations deliver accurate, consistent, and contextualized data across operational and analytical systems. 

Data Integrity Suite for Government enables users to discover and catalog data assets, manage metadata and lineage, and apply configurable governance workflows and stewardship processes to support collaboration between technical and business users. Automated metadata discovery, flexible data models, and machine learning-assisted classification support the organization and management of critical data at scale. The Data Integrity Suite can also verify, geocode, and autocomplete addresses, helping ensure the accuracy and reliability of critical address data.

By cataloging data from across cloud and on-prem data sources, the Data Integrity Suite for Government supports consistent management and use of trusted data across public sector agencies and adjacent regulated industries.

cso: Clarivate Intellectual Property AI & Image Search Platform (CIPAI-ISP)
service_desc:
The Clarivate Intellectual Property AI & Image Search Platform (CIPAI-ISP) is a search engine of Clarivate’s intellectual property datasets (such as designs, patents, trademarks). Users can search by uploading an image or text as query into the web search interface. Matched results are returned and displayed in the user interface for users to analyze and generate reports. 

CIPAI-ISP is delivered via SaaS. It is hosted in AWS GovCloud. It is available to federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as federal contractors, government contractors.

Coralogix US GovOps is a Software as a Service (SaaS) cloud analytics platform for customer’s observability data including logs, metrics, traces and security data using a real-time streaming pipeline. This solution provides monitoring, visualization, and alerting capabilities by enabling users to define different data pipelines per use case. Customers are able to analyze and monitor all system data in a single, centralized platform where any data can be connected in any format, from any source, to visualize and query together using any syntax for extensive event correlation and streamlined troubleshooting.

Pagefreezer’s website archiving service uses crawling technology, similar to that of Google, to take snapshots of an agency’s website(s). Archiving is an automated and scalable process and requires no software installation. With dynamic monitoring, new webpages and changes to existing pages are always captured, so the website archive is up to date.

Confluent Cloud for Government (CCG) Software-as-a-Service
(SaaS) is a fully managed, cloud-native Kafka service for connecting
and processing data using a cloud computing environment. It enables
its customers to focus on business needs instead of managing the
underlying infrastructure supporting their Kafka instances(s). It is
available to public, federal, state, local and tribal governments, as well
as research institutions, federal contractors, government contractors,
etc.

The CCG offering is comprised of two components – the Cloud
Control Plane and Data Plane (Kafka clusters). The Cloud Control
Plane is hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS) GovCloud and
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and is used by customers to select and
deploy their managed Kafka resources to a Satellite Cluster. The
Satellite Cluster consists of one or many Kubernetes nodes running
Kafka, with the one or many availability zones (AZs) deployed based
on options selected by the customer. A customer can choose to
deploy a Satellite Cluster to AWS GovCloud. The Control Plane is
used to manage resources in Satellite Clusters using the Control
Pipeline. All customer data is retained in Satellite Clusters and no
customer data from the Satellite Clusters is sent to the Control Plane.

Avature is a leading provider of enterprise Human Capital Management software solutions that comprise Avature’s Total Talent Management Framework solution suite. 
 
Avature Federal Platform is a highly configurable Human Capital Management System, which enables U.S. federal, state, and local government customers, as well as U.S. government contractors, and Federally Funded Research and Development Centers (FFRDCs) to implement modern approaches to help identify, attract, hire, develop and retain talented people in highly competitive labor markets. Avature’s suite of Human Capital Management SaaS (HCM SaaS) solutions can be implemented under a no-code methodology either individuality, in combination sets, or holistically. HCM SaaS solutions available on the Avature Federal Platform include: Applicant Tracking, Campus Recruiting, Career Sites & Talent Communities, Case Management, Events Management, Employee Social Learning/UpSkilling, Internal Talent Mobility, Performance Management.

The DTEX InTERCEPT for Government platform is a SaaS offering that combines Data Loss Prevention, User Behavior Analysis, and User Activity Monitoring to detect and mitigate insider risks before data loss occurs, enabling agencies to meet the requirements of the CNSSD 504 directive for UAM with built-in UEBA.   

DTEX InTERCEPT for Government ingests behavioral telemetry into the platform, and uses data science and AI to surface early-warning indicators for detecting and deterring insider risks.

The BlackOhm Omega Platform is a real-time personnel and asset tracking service consisting of tracking devices and a single pane of glass management interface. Government agencies and entities seeking a FedRAMP certified service can use the Omega Platform to organize, monitor, and manage training exercises and field work in any environment. The Omega Platform provides advanced functionality for situational awareness, including:

- Real-time and historical location data

- Personnel-initiated emergency messages and acknowledgements

- Event driven alerting

- Configurable boundaries, restricted areas, map overlays, and points of interest

- After-action reports and analytics

DimensionalView® is a secure, reliable cloud-based Platform as a Service (PaaS) hosted in Azure. It allows government users to capture, store, analyze, and visualize spatial and non-spatial data and create custom low-code-no-code applications and workflow management solutions in a collaborative workspace.

The system provides the following capabilities:

·         Identity and access-controlled data and document collaboration

·         Custom mapping, dashboarding, and reporting

·         Field inspections and data collection on mobile devices

·         No-code, low-code or full custom-coded applications depending on need

·         Secure and reliable data

·         Monitoring, logging, and reporting consistent with FedRAMP Moderate standards and guidelines

A fully managed and compliant DevSecOps platform to deliver cloud-hosted software to government end- users, enabling U.S Government departments and agencies to adopt, integrate and scale commercial technology for their unique missions. 2F Game Warden PaaS ensures commercial SaaS offerings conform to government security, compliance, and continuous monitoring standards in order to meet accreditation requirements. Second Front Systems is responsible for the maintenance and management of 2F Game Warden.

Kernos is a multi-tenant, cloud-native “SaaS” (software-as-a-service) cloud service offering (CSO). It leverages Amazon Web Services (AWS), IaaS (infrastructure-as-a-service), and PaaS (platform-as-a-service) for its underlying infrastructure and hardware.

Kernos integrates near-real-time video exploitation, common operating picture (COP), advanced multimedia and full motion video (FMV) (unclassified videos), ultimate web-based communication, collaboration, and information sharing tools, advanced file management, targeting databases, fast & reliable LLM-based translation micro-service, state-of-the-art facial recognition, and object detection with built-in artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML)-based alerts,  and notifications capabilities into a cost-effective solution.

This combination of real-time data and advanced modern technology gives government and commercial customers a bird’s-eye view of operations, enabling decision-makers to plan and manage operations strategically.

Healthcare Safeware® is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Government-only community cloud computing environment. It is available to any agency in the federal government.  Safeware® manages the workflow for healthcare clinical case reviews, captures quality, safety, and patient experience data, analyzes the data, and provides prioritization for needed process improvements that will improve healthcare outcomes for veterans and federal employees.

Adopt modern and efficient cloud-based technologies while safeguarding the security of federal information with GitLab Dedicated for Government. GitLab offers the most comprehensive, developer-preferred, customizable DevSecOps Platform as a single-tenant SaaS deployment. Delivered as a dedicated, isolated environment for each customer, this solution features data residency controls, advanced search capabilities, secure private networking, enterprise encryption, and integration with identity providers (IDPs).

GitLab Dedicated for Government strategically consolidates development tools, delivering measurable improvements in deployment velocity while maintaining strict security compliance. The solution streamlines workflows through integrated automation, configurable security controls, and end-to-end visibility across the entire software lifecycle. With GitLab, government agencies can accelerate innovation while ensuring their supply chain remains secure from code to cloud.

Atlassian Government Cloud is a Software as a Service (SaaS) offering that helps teams collaborate, track work, manage IT service delivery, support their DevOps practices and more - all with the security and control that agencies need. Available products include:

- Jira for project management across business and software teams

- Confluence for knowledge management and documentation

- Jira Service Management for IT service management, including support, IT operations, customer service, and more

Federal agencies interested in collaborative continuous monitoring with Atlassian Government Cloud should reach out to: agc-conmon-collab@atlassian.com

Altana, the world’s first Value Chain Management System (VCMS), is a common operating picture for the global supply chain, connecting the most important organizations across the public and private sectors into a shared source of truth.

Altana enables government agencies and the defense industrial base to see their actual value chains situated within a dynamic map of the global supply chain, focus on their priorities with AI support, and act to master their global value chains:

- National Security: Altana provides government agencies and the military industrial base with a dynamic, networked, common operating picture of the global supply chain.

- Law Enforcement: Altana helps regulators and enforcement agencies enforce laws across global value chain networks, and engage the private sector constructively on compliance from a shared source of truth.

- Customs Enforcement and Trade Facilitation: Altana enables customs authorities to illuminate, enforce, and facilitate compliant global value chains for goods crossing their borders.

- Economic Security: Altana enables policymakers to see, simulate, and collaborate across global value chains ensuring the security of critical industries and resources.

Altana’s mission is to provide cutting-edge technology to deliver global-scale supply chain visibility, threat network visibility, federated customer data integration, and public-private engagement capabilities.

Everfox ULTRA is a cloud-delivered, Hardsec-enforced service offering using a multi-tenant cloud computing environment to deliver a secure web browsing service designed to meet stringent security standards, including FedRAMP compliance. It provides a verifiably secure and isolated web browsing experience that prevents web threats, including zero-day attacks, zero-click exploits, and AI-accelerated phishing. Everfox ULTRA uses trusted Garrison Isolation Appliances (GIAs) and Garrison Transfer Appliances (GTAs) located in several global datacenters to isolate end users from potentially harmful websites, transforming risky web content into safe, interactive video streams. This approach ensures a high-assurance, performant user experience without compromising security. Additionally, the Everfox ULTRA Cloud Platform ensures that users' internet data is preserved between browsing sessions, allowing for a seamless and continuous browsing experience.
 
The GIA is engineered in line with the National Cross Domain Strategy & Management Office (NCDSMO) ""Raise the Bar"" (RTB) guidelines, ensuring it meets the high-security standards required for cross domain solutions. Everfox is committed to strict adherence to worldwide mandates, including FedRAMP, ensuring that the ULTRA Cloud Platform meets the necessary compliance requirements for federal agencies.

The RegScale Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM) Platform is delivered as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) offering, hosted in a multi-tenant public cloud computing environment. Built on Microsoft Azure, RegScale provides next-generation Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) capabilities that allow organizations to automate and accelerate the management of cybersecurity programs such as FISMA, FedRAMP, CMMC, PCI, HIPAA, and others.

RegScale helps organizations address their most difficult compliance challenges by enabling customers—via robust API integrations—to manage controls, upload evidence documentation, perform system assessments, and maintain certifications and authorizations. This is all centralized within a single platform, offering a “single pane of glass” experience. Automation ensures that data and compliance posture are updated in near real-time.

RegScale ensures that security and privacy-related controls are properly identified, implemented, and maintained throughout the System Development Lifecycle (SDLC) for systems, applications, services, processes, and related initiatives. The platform enables customers to establish and maintain an information assurance capability, including Control Validation Testing, to verify that appropriate controls are operational and risks are managed prior to production deployment.

While RegScale may be designated a major application for many large organizations, it is not typically classified as mission-critical. RegScale is a modern, cloud-native application, designed to scale using Docker containers, which are micro-segmented and orchestrated using Microsoft Azure services. The system is designed to be hosted in any environment, with security-focused runtime configuration through environmental variable injection.

Overleaf is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Public Cloud cloud computing environment. Overleaf is an online collaborative writing and publishing tool that makes the whole process of writing, editing and publishing scientific and technical documents much quicker and easier. Overleaf provides the convenience of an easy-to-use LaTeX editor with real-time collaboration and the fully compiled output produced automatically.

The AMPS system boundary is a General Support System (GSS) that is made up of operating systems (OS) and services designed to run on third-party cloud hosting platforms.  The purpose of this system is to allow USDA customers to leverage the robust capabilities of a FedRAMP cloud service provider (CSP) hosting environment for application delivery while DISC maintains the full management of the OS and services required to meet DISC controls at the High baseline level.  The FedRAMP’ed CSPs are outside of the security boundary and AMPS inherits controls from the CSP. 

The AMPS system is a major part of DISC’s cloud service offering for applications external to DISC. The system enables applications running in the cloud environment to take advantage of CSP virtualization of their computing environments. CSP virtualization alongside the Highly Available (HA) network that AMPS runs on, provides applications leveraging this environment with many advantages over a typical physical computing environment including, but not limited to, faster processing, greater up-time, and redundancy.   

The AMPS system is not publicly accessible. This system is only available to organizations who contract with DISC. No entity outside of the USDA (external users) has access to this system.

CrestPoint Environmental Management Service (CEMS) Platform 
 In accordance with FedRAMP requirements and policies, CrestPoint Solutions has completed the FedRAMP review process and is ready to support agency requests.
The CrestPoint Environmental Management Service (CEMS) Platform or the Unified FME Platform is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Public Cloud computing environment. It is a multipurpose modular system available to hospitals, healthcare facilities, data centers, public commercial facilities, federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors, and government contractors. The system is used by mission-critical facilities such as hospitals and data centers for managing operational and facility data including infrastructure data and asset management. 
 
For VA hospitals and other healthcare facilities, CEMS helps the EVS team manage infection prevention efforts. It provides the necessary oversight to manage and monitor EVS operations in a consolidated approach for the following EVS scopes of service: managing and tracking quality inspections and deficiencies for performance improvement, tracking bed turnover, reporting and analyzing textile care production data and cost of operations, managing day-to-day EVS key performance metrics, managing EVS key performance indicators (KPI), and incorporating integrated pest management (IPM) actions taken to address identified/reported deficiencies.
 
CEMS was uniquely designed to efficiently help EVS Leadership manage regulatory mandates such as the VHA Directive 1850 and others like The Joint Commission (TJC) Environment of Care (EC) Standards, CDC Sanitization Guidelines, CMS Infection Control, EPA/OSHA Medical Waste Regulations, Healthcare Laundry Accreditation Council (HLAC) Standards, and Integrated Pest Management (IPM) Protocols. These are mandated directives. Failure to adequately track infection prevention efforts, the various deficiencies, and the management of the EVS Key Performance Indicators (KPI) will directly affect the health and well-being of veterans and patients. A possible consequence is an infection outbreak or even an epidemiological outbreak.
 
As a result of these digital records, EVS staff and management have access to improved metrics that help put patients first, providing them with much better quality of care, faster response times and improved safety. Electronic records enable EVS teams to address patient needs in real time, eliminating wait times and backlog in EVS operations.
For Data Centers and infrastructure management, CEMS provides an integrated detailed specification and graphical representation of equipment for capacity planning. CEMS is used for power, space, and power requirements. It facilitates the automation and verification of scheduled and preventative maintenance, true-ups and end-of-life notifications. CEMS addresses today’s critical infrastructure challenges such as: floor space management, network connectivity, asset management, live power and environmental monitoring, critical AC - DC power systems, integrates with live data, Intelligent business analytics. It has the capability for multiple site management, measures PUE and/or DCiE, capacity planning, an intuitive, web-based graphical user interface (GUI), online collaboration and scheduling tools, easily manages work orders and resources, and provides a centralized repository for site drawings.
Our commitment to FedRAMP requirements reflects our dedication to protecting sensitive data and upholding the highest security standards.

The Federal Immersive Learning Management System (FED ILMS) is an Immersive Learning Management System (ILMS) which allows for training to occur in multiple modalities. Includes:
-        Live Meeting (Webinar Capabilities)
-        eLearning (SCORM, xAPI, CMI5, etc.)
-        On-Demand Video content
-        Documents
-        Immersive Learning (3D based serious gaming, in multi-player or single player mode)

User interactions are tracked for the purposes of determining when the user has met requirements of various courses. 

In addition, the application has the following features:
Accreditation System: Application has a complete accreditation system, which allows for the tracking of certificate requirements for any content in the system and puts the user through a number of requirements in order to achieve certification. This includes pre/post tests, evaluations, confirmation of acceptance, etc.

Event Registration System: System has a complete registration system to manage Live Webinar registration as well as course registration. 

Exhibit Hall Capabilities: Create the ability to create templated “Spaces” or content areas that can be edited by “space editors” which includes a complete capability for the delegation of editing content in the space to the right department or person that manages that space. Spaces create an area where the “exhibitor” can share documents, live chat, provide contact information, display videos, and have “Ad-Hoc” live meetings.

Open AI: Application will, through the use of Cognitive Search, index the content in the application tagging it to a particular space, exhibit space, webinar, eLearning course, etc. This indexed content is then integrated with Open AI using the RAG pattern to feed the LLM to have a conversation within the content, which is context based (within a space, related to a course, etc.)

Game API: External immersive learning experiences (serious Games) use the Game API to manage the user’s session, which includes the ability to set and get user progress, mark objectives as met, etc. In addition, the Game API allows for the management of VoIP in the case of multi-player games, and also for the real-time communications using Sockets over https for presence management and other real-time multi-player communication needs.

Search Capabilities: Application has a comprehensive search feature which allows users to search the system across all content types and one click open the content from the search results, whether this content is a Webinar, an Exhibit Space, a Serious Game, or a Document.

Rating and Favorites: System has the ability for the user to rate (providing this is enabled), and mark any content or space in the system as favorite, and this shows up in the user’s favorites as well “My Office” 

My Office: This is the space within the application where the user sees all of the training they have done, can print certificates, finish any certificate requirements they have not completed on any of the course or content they have consumed, access their favorites, edit their profiles, etc.

Social Features: Application has real-time group chat and real-time one-on-one chat available throughout the application for real-time chat scenarios. This is useful within the context of spaces, live webinars, etc. The application also has a simple moderated Forums capability to allow the user to participate in forums which can be scoped to a space, content, or general in nature.

CMS: The application has an administrative interface, called the “CMS” which allows the client administrator to manage all aspects of the platform. Access can be granularly assigned to only the features required, through which elevated access can be made available to manage system settings which are sensitive in nature.

The Verkada Command Platform is Verkada’s government-grade offering designed to help government organizations and their partners take a proactive, simple, and scalable approach to physical security, alongside numerous security enhancements that are critical for certain government users.

The system consists of the following key features: 
* Command in AWS GovCloud 
* Verkada Command, Pass, and Guest Mobile Applications
* Cellular Gateway
* FIPS-validated Devices including Video Security, Physical Access Control, Air Quality Sensors, Guest Management, and Command Connector

IBM Envizi ESG Suite is an ESG reporting software from  IBM® Envizi™ integrates a suite of products that help you capture and manage all your ESG data in a single system of record and report with confidence knowing that your data is auditable and finance-grade.
IBM Envizi ESG Suite is a cloud based, SaaS solution that consolidates enterprise ESG data for analysis and reporting. It simplifies data collection by capturing and tracking ESG and sustainability program data such as forecasts, timelines, cash flow, objectives and deliverables in a central system. It provides a data management foundation designed to create a single, trusted data source for all ESG reporting and opportunity identification. Key features include automatic data capture, data normalizations, data structuring and hierarchy management, data audits and health checks.

ScienceLogic Government Cloud includes the ScienceLogic SL1 platform for automated discovery, performance and event management along with business services management and visualization. ScienceLogic PowerFlow works in tandem with the SL1 platform to deliver automations in real-time integration with third-party applications.
 
Key capabilities include:
 
 - Automated Discovery and Relationship Mapping – Discovery of devices across the hybrid IT ecosystem, as well as continuous data collection, providing up-to-date information to the analytics engine

 - Comprehensive Monitoring & Analytics - Real-time visibility and analysis across hybrid IT environments

 - Service-Centric Observability - Business service views delivering health and performance insights

 - Automated Operations – Advanced workflow automation for incident response and workflow management

Integration Service – Intelligent, bidirectional integration capabilities with third-party applications such as ServiceNow and other essential platforms
The Yardi Government Cloud is the underlying PAAS on which Yardi's SAAS offerings for the government sector are hosted.

FedSuite is offered as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution within a multi-tenant, government-exclusive community computing environment, available to federal customers. This suite of web-based applications delivers agency-specific insights by analyzing employee and workforce data. The intuitive interfaces of FedSuite tools enable agencies to gain actionable insights and a comprehensive understanding of their workforces from various perspectives. FedSuite includes the following applications: FedChart, FedLens, and FedViews.

FedChart (fedchart.com) is a workforce planning tool that automates the creation, maintenance, and updating of organizational charts, adhering to agency-specific business rules and requirements. Utilizing federal HR data, FedChart visualizes an agency’s structure, positions, and workforce. The process begins with building the agency’s framework using organizational levels and work units. Next, positions and their descriptions are added to this framework. Finally, employee data is mapped to positions to depict the current workforce. Agencies can use FedChart to request new positions, reallocate positions between organizations, and initiate hiring actions for new or vacant positions. Agency HR administrators can review and approve or reject changes to positions, hiring requests, and work unit modifications in accordance with agency protocols and objectives. 

FedLens (fedlens.com) is a research-based tool designed to enhance data-driven workforce management and planning through automated reports, trend analysis, and predictive analytics. It comprises three modules: Diagnostics, Snapshots, and Predictions.

FedLens Diagnostics leverages current workforce data to identify risks in areas such as capacity, diversity, skills, performance, and workforce engagement. This data is benchmarked against standards from the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) and other agencies to assess organizational health.

FedLens Snapshots automates the generation of HR reports commonly required by leadership, offering detailed insights into the onboard workforce.

FedLens Predictions aids agencies in proactive preparation and planning.

FedViews (fedviews.com) is an automated tool for Federal Employee Viewpoint Survey (FEVS) reporting, trend analysis, and workforce planning. It assists federal agencies in generating FEVS reports in compliance with Office of Personnel Management (OPM) requirements. FedViews enables federal HR leaders to compare viewpoint data over time, identify trends, and benchmark scores across departments and within agencies. Utilizing FEVs results, FedViews allows for the development, implementation, and tracking of action plans to improve the work environment.

Cora PPM provides US Government agencies and DoD with a single Enterprise solution to manage all projects, programs, and initiatives, across their entire portfolio.

By providing a single solution, Cora PPM ensures that all aspects of Project execution, from CIO to the Project Manager and any Contractors in support, have a single experience to ensure that their projects are on-time and on budget.

Cora PPM enables organizations and agencies the ability to manage: Workforce Planning, Enterprise and Project Financials, Scheduling, Project Controls, Risks and Opportunities, Timesheets, Forecasting, Contractor Portal, and more all with embedded Workflow, Smart Forms and Registers all in a single experience.

With more Agencies looking to execute their Mission’s with fewer resources or strained Staff, Cora PPM enables quicker decision making and execution by ensuring that all Project management data is within reach with the right context.

The platform supports both dynamic as well as locked down Role creation to ensure the right data is available to the right staff.

Embedded Audit controls ensure that as Projects iterate, all changes and versions are available for quick recall to ensure that information is never lost.

Supporting both Project management execution, as well as ideation and innovation in a single Enterprise platform with Click to Config controls, ensures both a high ROI and lower TCO from other solutions in the marketplace.

With both on-prem and cloud utilization, Cora PPM ensures Agencies with Classified Programs and Projects can leverage PPM excellence regardless of Mission parameters.

Regulatory agencies use DocketScope® software to analyze public comments received as part of notice-and-comment rulemaking and other government agency actions, such as requests for information. Our SaaS product automatically loads comments from Regulations.gov and other sources, including FDMS extracts, identifies identical and similar comments, tags comments containing keywords, and highlights differences between similar comments. Users categorize comment submissions (e.g., unique, duplicate, or form letter, commenter type, etc.), manage an outline of issues raised by commenters, and map substantive text from comments to those issues with just a few clicks. Automation and optional AI support users to maximize accuracy and efficiency. DocketScope’s dashboard delivers real-time visibility of progress and findings. Users also can easily generate a variety of standard or tailored reports. DocketScope empowers agencies by simplifying the analysis of public comments, increasing staff productivity and improving quality.

Connect.Gov is delivered as a Software as a Service (SaaS) offering using a multi-tenant “Government-Only Cloud” cloud computing environment. It is available to federal government departments and agencies employees and contractors.

LCPtracker Pro is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Public Cloud cloud computing environment. It is available to public commercial enterprises, federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors, and government contractors. LCPtracker Pro is a cloud-based prevailing wage and workforce compliance management solution. The application is ideal for public agencies and prime contractors that are responsible for keeping all contractors on their project, even down to the lower-tier subcontractors, compliant. Additionally, clients can track detailed worker information and leverage dynamic reporting to monitor workforce initiatives.

The Cellebrite Government Cloud (CGC) is a SaaS solution that is operational within Amazon Web Services (AWS) GovCloud. 

The CGC enables customers to extract and analyze digital forensic evidence from mobile devices, such as phones and tablets. Using Cellebrite’s Digital Forensics Suite and
Investigative Suite, customers can leverage features such as device unlocking, data extraction, data analysis, information sharing, and reporting without compromising the integrity or chain of custody of the mobile device.

The Varonis Data Security Platform is a cloud-hosted data security platform for protecting and governing enterprise data. Varonis DSP protects the most used data stores by enforcing least privilege, fixing misconfigurations, inventorying and labeling critical data sets, and stopping insider threats.

With the Varonis DSP agencies can meet EO 14028 requirements to establish zero trust by inventorying and protecting their most sensitive data. OMB 22-09 data pillar and identity requirements can be fulfilled automatically with Varonis’ powerful automation suite. The Varonis DSP tracks all user activity around cloud platforms and aggregates these logs in a single source. Varonis’ advanced user and entity behavior analytics helps to identify compromises by understanding anomalous behavior at the file level, easily fulfilling OMB 21-31 up to EL-3. Automated dashboards track various Federal regulations (i.e. NIST 800-53) for easy compliance reporting.

Varonis integrates with agencies most used data stores like M365, NAS devices, Unix/Linux, and other cloud collaboration tools to give customers a holistic view of their data. Varonis can be used to address these important use cases and more: 
Detecting insider threats and cyberattacks: Varonis provides behavior-based threat detection that uses machine learning to alert on abnormal user or device behavior. Additionally, Varonis provides a live-updating library of pre-built threat models based on attack techniques and vulnerabilities used by real-world adversaries.
Pinpointing data exposure: Varonis automatically classifies sensitive data, highlights where information is exposed externally or internally, and automatically removes unnecessary access to enforce least privilege.

Limiting the blast radius of an attack: Varonis safely automates permissions changes to eliminate unnecessary access and drastically reduces the damage from insider threats and cyberattacks.

Tracking Email Abuses : Varonis scans inside of emails/attachments and captures all user email activity while alerting on abuses, tracking spillage, and mapping the exact flow of sensitive data through email platforms. 

Achieving compliance: Varonis’ vast library of classification rules can discover sensitive data related to GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI, CUI, FTI, CJIS, Secret, Top Secret and more. The permissions analysis and continual monitoring Varonis provides gives auditors a real-time pulse on compliance and helps customers achieve compliance with NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, RMF, CMMC, IRS Pub 1075 and more.

Varonis DatAdvantage Cloud is a cloud-hosted data security platform for protecting and governing enterprise data. Varonis DatAdvantage Cloud protects data wherever it lives by reducing unnecessary access, fixing misconfigurations, inventorying and labeling critical data sets, and stopping insider threats.

With Varonis DatAdvantage Cloud agencies can meet EO 14028 requirements to establish zero trust by inventorying and protecting their most sensitive data. OMB 22-09 data pillar and identity requirements can be fulfilled automatically with DatAdvantage Cloud's powerful automation suite. DatAdvantage Cloud tracks all user activity around cloud platforms and aggregates these logs in a single source. Varonis’ advanced user and entity behavior analytics helps to identify compromises by understanding anomalous behavior at the file/object level, easily fulfilling OMB 21-31 up to EL-3. Automated dashboards track various Federal regulations (i.e. NIST 800-53) for easy compliance reporting.

Varonis DatAdvantage cloud integrates with a wide array of data repositories, SaaS applications, and cloud infrastructure to give customers a holistic view of their data. Varonis can be used to address these important use cases and more:
Detecting insider threats and cyberattacks: Varonis DatAdvantage Cloud detects threats to data, including insider threats and external cyberattacks with a live-updating library of pre-built threat models based on attack techniques and vulnerabilities used by real-world adversaries.

Limiting the blast radius of an attack: Varonis DatAdvantage Cloud analyzes where there is unnecessary access to data and can eliminate excessive access at scale, drastically reducing the damage from insider threats and cyberattacks.

Blink Network provides a comprehensive solution for electric vehicle (EV) charging, employing a container-based, microservices architecture to allow for the management of charging stations, as well as a wide array of host and driver services.
Charger Services
The core of the Blink Network revolves around its charger services, which include:
Access Control and Billing: Users are authenticated and billed based on their usage. The system supports detailed billing that can differentiate between driver pricing and other billing factors.
Charging Session History: Each charging session is
 logged, capturing details such as duration, energy consumed, and cost, enabling precise tracking and management.
Charging Station Configuration: Administrators can configure charging stations remotely, setting parameters such as maximum output and scheduling.
Customer Services
To enhance the EV driver experience, Blink Network offers several customer-oriented services:
Station Locator: Drivers can find available public charging stations via the network, ensuring they can charge their vehicles conveniently.
Session Management: Drivers can start and pay for charging sessions directly through the platform, supported by a seamless payment gateway.
Notification Alerts: Users receive notifications about their charging status and other relevant alerts, enhancing communication and user engagement.
Station Management
Station management is critical for operational efficiency and includes:
Pricing Policy Management: Administrators can set and adjust pricing based on duration or kWh used, allowing for flexible and dynamic pricing strategies.
Access Policy Settings: Stations can be configured for public, private, or mixed use. Public stations can be integrated with popular mapping services like Google and Apple Maps for easy accessibility.
Reporting: Comprehensive reports are available, detailing transactions, energy usage, revenue, station utilization, and environmental impact metrics.
Real-time Monitoring: Continuous monitoring of station status with alerts ensures high uptime and prompt response to issues.
Driver Mobile App
The driver-facing component of the Blink Network includes:
Account Management: Drivers can manage their profiles, set notification preferences, and enter payment information for automated billing.
Charging Management: The app provides functionalities to find stations, check availability, initiate, and pay for charging sessions, all in real-time.
API Integration
API capabilities are central to the system, facilitating:
Charging Operations (OCPI): Supports authentication and control of charging sessions.
Charger Information (OCPI): Delivers real-time data on charger status, tariffs, and locations.
CDR and Reports (OCPI): Provides detailed reports on energy consumption, parking duration, and costs for effective management.
Data Security
Data integrity and security are prioritized with stringent measures for data at rest and in transit, including:
Host Information: Only essential details are stored, ensuring privacy and compliance.
Driver Information: Sensitive information such as credit card details are tokenized; actual card numbers are never stored.
Charging Station and Session Details: Comprehensive logging includes all transactional data without compromising user privacy.

ESChat for Government is a hardened version of the ESChat broadband communication, collaboration, and interoperability platform. ESChat is a Secure Broadband Push-to-Talk (PTT) communication system that facilitates secure inter-agency PTT communication, multimedia messaging, and a Common Operating Picture (COP) within and between agencies for mutual-aid or tactical purposes. ESChat for Government also supports external interfaces including Land Mobile Radio (LMR), dispatch consoles, and logging recorders

There are three main components that make up this offering:

- The ESChat portal is a browser-based application which allows customers to manage all aspects of their network including managing accounts, devices, groups, integrations,live and historical location display, etc.
- The ESChat clients are mobile applications (Android, iOS, Linux), Land Mobile Radio (LMR) gateways, and PC Client applications that communicate using the ESChat protocol. The ESChat clients are the functional endpoints that the users of the system interact with to perform Push-to-Talk voice and multimedia messaging communications with one another.
- The ESChat back-end services provide ESChat users with inter-carrier, inter-agency, inter-system, and inter-vendor interoperability all managed and controlled within the authorization boundary, ensuring ESChat is the only solution needed to provide reliable, secure, and interoperable communications.

Abnormal AI for Government (Abnormal Gov) is a cloud-native, API-based offering that provides holistic email security for cloud email platforms – Microsoft365 and Google Workspace, against the full spectrum of email attacks including advanced phishing, fraud, account compromise, supply chain compromise, user-reporting phishing, and more.
The platform connects via API to analyze thousands of signals from multiple data sets and precisely baseline known behavior of every employee within an organization and every vendor within the supply chain. Autonomous AI models enable Abnormal Gov to detect anomalous activity and stop never-before-seen attacks quickly and accurately. The platform also serves as an AI Security Co-worker by fully automating the triage and remediation of user-reported emails. AI models judge user-reported emails as safe, spam, or malicious and automatically remediate malicious emails across all affected users using AI, eliminating any manual intervention by security analysts. Additionally, AI models automatically learn the behavioral preferences of every employee through their folder movements of graymail and autonomously declutter inboxes from unwanted mail thereby boosting employee productivity.

Abnormal Gov’s cloud email security product suite includes Inbound Email Security, Email Account Takeover Protection, AI Security Mailbox, Email Security Posture Management, and Email Productivity. The platform leverages a multi-tenant government cloud computing environment and is available for public, federal, state, local, and tribal governments.

The Paramify Cloud (Paramify) is a software platform that automates risk management processes—including compliance planning, solution implementation, gap assessments, and documentation—for cloud service providers, government agencies, and members of the Defense Industrial Base (DIB).

Paramify supports adherence to control catalog requirements including NIST 800-53 (FedRAMP, FISMA, GovRAMP, TX-RAMP), NIST 800-171 (CMMC), and standards such as SOC 2, HIPAA, and ISO 27001, with support for additional catalogs and profiles continually expanding.

SSP and ATO Package Management

  ∙ Fast and Easy Setup: Upload previous SSPs or use the intake process to identify your system’s elements and security capabilities. Paramify then generates a roadmap to support your risk management and compliance objectives.

  ∙ Streamlined Control Implementation & Optimization: Visualize progress and manage security program capabilities through a unified dashboard that tracks system elements and responsibilities.

  ∙ ATO Package Generation: Produce accurate SSP documentation in both digital (OSCAL) and human-readable formats, with flexible export options that support various file types, including but not limited to OSCAL, PDF, Word, and Excel.

  ∙ Incorporate Changes Efficiently: As your risk management approach evolves, maintaining stack profiles in Paramify reduces manual update errors across documentation. Paramify automatically synchronizes updates to your SSP, CRM, CIS, policies, procedures, and other records to support compliance with evolving data protection requirements.

Continuous Monitoring and Issue Management

  ∙ Automated POA&M Documentation: Automatically manage and update POA&M documentation via a centralized task-priority view, eliminating the need to manage from multiple spreadsheets or scan files.

  ∙ Vulnerability Management with Duplicate Detection: Automatically close resolved vulnerabilities and employ duplicate detection to ensure accurate issue tracking.

  ∙ Automated Risk Adjustment: Apply risk adjustments across multiple issues automatically to support consistent prioritization of remediation efforts.

  ∙ Automated Inventory Reconciliation: Configure and maintain inventory reconciliation rules to generate accurate workbooks automatically, without manual review of scan files—including those for ephemeral virtual hosts.

Integration with Your Organization’s Processes

  ∙ Workflow Management: Integrate with issue management tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, GitLab) to facilitate collaboration between DevOps and security teams for timely issue remediation.

  ∙ Evidence Management: Unified evidence approach that minimizes or eliminates duplicate collection efforts.

  ∙ API Integrations: Paramify’s open API supports custom integrations with system components to facilitate connectivity and interoperability.

Available in SaaS and self-hosted implementations.
